title: Appeal on Ban

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

You were banned for posting malicious Links in chat.

Since you have no Evidence to show to me that the ban was false it will remain valid.

replies.author: Princezz_Dubstep
replies.body:
Heyo, 

If you cannot provide us with sufficient evidence of you claiming that you've never posted malicious links, then, your ban will not be lifted and will remain valid as stated prior. 

Please wait your ban out awhile longer before attempting to appeal. 

Thank you!
